**[P1] Re-check revocation after retryable exceptions finish cleanup**

This still raises from inside the `ExitStack`. If an in-flight checkpoint returns without a token while `execution_state.close()` joins the batcher, revocation is recorded during unwinding, so the post-`with` override is skipped and Lambda retries with a revoked token. Capture the retryable exception, finish cleanup, return bare `PENDING` if revocation was observed, and otherwise re-raise. Add a cleanup-race test using a retryable `InvocationError`.
